name: 王夏娃
major: Materials Science, Electromagnetics, Energy Materials and Devices

paper_description: Her research integrates materials science and electromagnetics, controlling the emission spectra of high-temperature emitters through micro-nano structures. She is dedicated to developing devices and systems for next-generation radioisotope batteries to power spacecraft for missions beyond Jupiter and into deep space where solar energy is insufficient. She is also interested in developing new materials and devices for energy applications.
